title: Deductions from the Business License Tax
issuer: City of Seattle, Office of City Finance

passages.question: Are the Bellevue and Tacoma jobs taxed by Seattle?
passages.excerpt: When you file, include the deduction amount in your gross amount. ... Taxed by other cities You can deduct revenue from the sale of tangible goods or retail services when you deliver them to another part of Washington, outside Seattle. Identify each city you deliver to. Use the Taxed by Other Cities deduction if the delivery location imposes a local gross receipts tax (B&O tax).

passages.question: Can the Fremont Bakehouse write-off be deducted?
passages.excerpt: Bad debts and uncollected revenue You can deduct money that you previously reported as taxable revenue but were later unable to collect.

passages.question: May subcontractor costs, materials or retainage be taken out of gross?
passages.excerpt: The costs of doing business cannot be deducted from your gross revenue amount. ... Only deductions specifically defined in the Seattle Municipal Code are allowed. ... Sales tax in gross Use this deduction to back out sales, admission or excise tax revenue that you included in the gross amount.
